status: Prepared locally for build 20; not saved to the pending build-11 Apple submission.
description:
Eight activities. One island to bring back to life.

Meet Lio, a keeper apprentice rebuilding Aurora Atoll after the Great Eclipse. Eight equally sized, labeled activity buttons show your progress. Shared supplies connect every adventure; swipe through Lio’s short stories to see how each helps restore six garden projects.

BLOOM CIRCUITS
Swipe neighboring flowers, leaves, apples, dew and diamonds to match three, or tap touching groups. Make Bomb, TNT, Mega Bomb and Rainbow formations and chain their blasts. Adjacent matches uncover one-hit mud gems, weaken two-hit ice and rope, and open three-hit sacks and water tubes. Each cascade damages a blocker at most once per action.

Explore 1,020 sequential stages across 102 swipe pages. New normal attempts are Hard or Super hard with 10–16 moves. Twenty One shot stages offer one free winning move; hints work while stock powers and extra moves stay out. Existing saved attempts retain their original rules.

Choose up to three starting powers before playing. New-level wins grow a free Bomb, TNT and Rainbow kit; losing or abandoning resets the streak. Earn or craft stock powers. Optional Pip costs 200 game coins and gives one hint per new campaign level, once per level.

LIVING FARM
Grow apple trees and roses in three saved fields with six patches each. Open the second after three harvests or adventure wins, and the third after nine. Bloom first clears, all five skill-game first clears and successful Rally deliveries count together. Swipe between fields, water crops, harvest with your sickle and craft powers in the shed. Crops grow while away. Harvests provide coins, compost and cargo.

HARVEST RALLY
Swipe your rover between three lanes. Avoid logs, cones and rocks; collect coins and complete 440 metres in 22 seconds. Start at hard tier 3; three and six successful deliveries raise traffic to tiers 4 and 5. Later rows can block two lanes. Farm cargo adds a delivery bonus. Each finished route banks its reward once.

FIVE MORE CHALLENGES
Canal Weave: rotate pipes to reconnect water.
Firefly Trail: watch lanterns, repeat their lights and see your progress.
Windmill Works: time charges inside a tightening window.
Moon Observatory: swipe numbered stars into an ordered chart.
Sky Shuttle: seat twelve travellers on two decks by window, front-row and companion tickets.

Each skill activity offers up to 1,000 seeded challenges. A new sequential clear earns one star, 25 coins and two water, once. Completed results and personal bests save; unfinished skill attempts are discarded when you leave or close the app.

PLAY AND SAVE
Your first ten hints and three shuffles are free. Earn more through permanent tasks or spend game coins. Five normal puzzle lives regenerate one every 30 minutes. Confirming a puzzle start spends one life; abandoning keeps it spent without a second charge; winning returns a normal life. The other seven activities use no puzzle lives.

Shared UTC events automatically feature the original skill activities, harvests and deliveries. Event bonuses need a recent online clock check; normal play works offline.

Optional Apple purchases provide coins, non-expiring reserve lives and a one-time First Bloom bundle. Apple displays local prices. Purchases add no ranking points.

Play as a guest or connect Game Center in Settings > Player & saved garden. Optional private iCloud backup includes progress, active puzzles, farm, coins, lives, tools and completed skill results. Use the same Apple accounts with iCloud Drive enabled and the same updated build on your devices. Choose which garden to continue when saves differ. Guest saves remain on this device and can be lost if the app is deleted.

Atoll Skills ranks the four original skill-game bests through Game Center; Shuttle records stay in your garden. Music, effects and haptics have separate controls. No ads or analytics.
reviewNotes:
Build 20: guest play and Apple purchases need no developer login. Eight illustrated buttons on the island open activities directly. X returns to the island. Shared water, seeds, compost and cargo update on the home screen after any reward. Lio's portrait opens eight swipeable story pages. All completed results and resources save in the same wallet.

Puzzle: the campaign action opens a three-slot power selector. Cancelling spends nothing; Play consumes one life and selected stock in the same checkpoint. First-clear streak rewards are free Bomb, TNT and Rainbow; loss or confirmed abandonment resets the kit. Optional Pip costs 200 game coins once and gives one hint per new level once. Normal new attempts have Hard/Super hard rules and 10–16 moves. One-shot challenges retain a free winning swipe and forbid starting powers, stock tools, shuffle, bursts and extra moves. Four in a line makes Bomb, L/T makes TNT, five makes Rainbow, and a seven-piece cross makes Mega. Tap or swap powers to chain blasts. Near matches reveal one-hit mud diamonds, two-hit ice/rope and three-hit sacks/tubes. A cascade damages each blocker once per action. Back/Pause requires confirmation; cancelling keeps the board. Abandon costs no second life. Restart opens the selector and charges only on Play. Old active rules remain unchanged.

Farm: six patches per saved field, three fields. Swipe horizontally. Fields 2 and 3 open at three and nine harvests or combined adventure wins: Bloom first clears, all five skill first clears and successful Rally deliveries. Locked fields show both counts. Abandoned/failed attempts and repeated skill/Bloom clears add no unlock progress. Apples grow in 45 seconds; roses in 30. Water advances a deadline by ten seconds. Harvest coins, compost and cargo; a short per-patch collection lock prevents rapid taps from replanting. The house opens the compost tool shed.

Rally: horizontal road swipes steer; vertical swipes do not. The graphical guide announces numbered obstacle and coin lanes for VoiceOver. Pause freezes the road. Each registered finish pays once; duplicate/stale callbacks are ignored. Early exit pays nothing. Complete 440 m in 22 s with shield remaining. Traffic starts at tier 3, rises after three and six completed deliveries, and caps at tier 5. Higher tiers have some two-obstacle rows with a safe coin lane.

Five skill games have 1,000 seeded challenges each. Canal rotates water pipes; Firefly repeats demonstrated lanterns and lights answers; Windmill uses timing or VoiceOver guided charge; Observatory slides an ordered chart; Shuttle seats twelve ticketed passengers across two decks. Same linked passengers need adjacent seats in one row; arrow/window/flag tickets choose deck/outside/front. Select a passenger then a seat; Depart checks all rules. Wrong checks and moves use the finite budget. Saving a new sequential result grants one star, 25 coins and two water exactly once. These activities use no puzzle lives and do not persist unfinished attempts.

Settings offers optional Game Center/private GameKit-iCloud Drive saves. Schema 4 includes fields, blocker layers, momentum and Shuttle results; older clients reject it rather than drop progress. Active games block restore; foreign accounts and missing credited receipts are rejected. Use your own Apple accounts with iCloud Drive enabled. No publisher player-save database or new collected-data category was added.

Six existing StoreKit products remain unchanged: four coin packs, a reserve-life pack and First Bloom. Credits are durable and idempotent; cancellation/pending transactions grant nothing. The existing 80,000-point Atoll Skills leaderboard sums only Canal, Firefly, Windmill and Observatory, with no purchase points or server anti-cheat. Shuttle scores remain local/private saves. The isolated HTTPS /api/events Worker supplies public UTC only and receives no player save, credential or purchase payload.

No ads or analytics. Manual public release remains selected.
promotionalText: Eight island adventures: hard swipe puzzles, three living farm fields, rover racing and clever two-deck Shuttle seating. Build Lio’s world with earned stars.
whatToTest: Check direct activity icons; cancel and confirm the three-slot kit; layered blockers; three farm fields and offline harvests; harder Rally lanes; glowing Firefly answers; Shuttle seating and saved first rewards. Verify Game Center, private iCloud and signed sandbox purchases on physical devices. Use build 20 on devices sharing schema-4 gardens. Check every labeled home activity, shared supply updates after wins/harvests/deliveries, restoration stars and all eight story pages. Check mixed-game field expansion at three and nine wins, locked-field progress and planted crops after relaunch. Check one Rally reward and cargo deduction per completed run, saved balance after relaunch, and no payout when leaving an unfinished route.
subtitle: Eight adventures. One island.
